pattern.description: As the transcript scrolls up, the key facts in each bubble (reference number, date, booking confirmation, amount due) are recoloured with a blue-violet gradient, roughly one bubble after another. This shows what the analysis pulled out.
pattern.why_premium: It shows the product's value (extracting insights from a transcript) directly on the UI, not with a caption. Using the brand gradient for the highlight ties it to the earlier headline, and pairing it with a gentle scroll keeps the frame alive without breaking the read.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.transcript', {y: -130, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.keyPhrase .word', {color: '#111'}, {color: 'var(--brand-gradient-stop)', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power1.out', stagger: 0.04}, 0.05) (or animate background-position on a background-clip:text gradient from 100% to 0%); new bubbles ride in with the scroll.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 20], [0, -130], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}) on the transcript. For each phrase word i, the gradient mix = interpolate(frame - 2 - i*1.2, [0, 9], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}), applied as background-clip text opacity over the black text.

notes: camera.move says tilt_down, but this is the transcript content scrolling up inside the UI, not a camera move. Some phrases (the reference number, the date) were already partly coloured at the burst start, so their highlight may carry over from e022. The b07 box covers the full first line; the highlighted span is only part of it plus b17.
